economic_rationale: TA-Lib-default KAMA30 adapts its recursive smoothing coefficient using net 30-day displacement divided by total absolute daily path movement. It is valuable only if close above KAMA30 retains material upside after costs, lowers drawdown, improves Calmar, survives annual breadth and remains stable at frozen KAMA20 and KAMA40 efficiency windows. Reduced exposure or adaptive smoothing alone cannot pass.
opportunity_cost: One exact historical decision is cheaper and more informative than waiting ninety days or building another data adapter. A failure permanently closes this KAMA20/30/40 close-above-adaptive-line family without initialization, period, constant, relation, confirmation or parent changes.
stop_conditions: Stop with DATA_REJECT before economics if any source hash, dataset hash, hourly lattice, OHLCV, complete UTC-day or KAMA arithmetic gate fails.
Stop with EVIDENCE_INSUFFICIENT before economics if TA-Lib initialization, unstable-period-zero handling or next-open availability is ambiguous.
Stop and permanently close the exact KAMA20/30/40 close-above-adaptive-line family if the primary or either rejection-only neighbor fails any frozen gate.
Do not select a neighbor after seeing outcomes even if it outperforms the primary.

Do not scan another KAMA efficiency period, fast or slow constant, initialization, unstable period, price source, relation, slope, crossover event, delay, holding period, confirmation, DRA combination or cost model after results.
Do not use post-2024 data; a pass may only become CANDIDATE_FROZEN_REPORTED_NOT_ACTIVATED with one independent sealed OOS still required.
thesis: When a completed-day BTC close remains above a KAMA whose smoothing accelerates with directional path efficiency and slows with choppiness, a causal next-open long/cash state may retain material efficient-trend upside while avoiding enough noisy or adverse paths to improve fee-adjusted risk-adjusted performance over full-capital buy-and-hold.

distinct_from_closed_families: Unlike the closed SMA150/200/250 family, KAMA uses a recursive line with a per-day smoothing coefficient driven by the ratio of net displacement to cumulative path movement.
Unlike the closed MACD family, KAMA compares close with one adaptive level and has no fixed-fast versus fixed-slow EMA spread or signal-line EMA.
Unlike the closed Supertrend and Donchian families, KAMA has no ATR band, ratcheting stop or rolling-extreme breakout.

Unlike the closed DRA intraday path-efficiency family, KAMA uses a thirty-complete-day close path to vary a standalone full-capital trend line rather than gating a lot-based parent with one-day H1 efficiency.
excluded_reinterpretations: Close strictly above KAMA30 is primary; KAMA20 and KAMA40 are rejection-only neighbors and cannot replace it.

No alternate efficiency period, fast or slow constant, initialization, unstable period, price source, slope, crossover event, equality, confirmation, delay, hold, stop, leverage, short leg, DRA interaction or ensemble may be scanned after outcome access.
A historical pass remains REPORTED_NOT_ACTIVATED and still requires one independent sealed OOS.
